scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter frontend build && powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path publish/frontend/dist | Out-Null; Copy-Item frontend/dist/* publish/frontend/dist -Recurse -Force"
scripts.build:api: dotnet publish backend/Wx3000.Backend.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true /p:PublishSingleFile=true -o publish/backend/Release
scripts.publish:server: pnpm --filter frontend build && dotnet publish backend/Wx3000.Backend.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o publish/Wx3000_Server/api && powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path publish/Wx3000_Server/api/wwwroot | Out-Null; Copy-Item frontend/dist/* publish/Wx3000_Server/api/wwwroot -Recurse -Force"
